screen.title: Conversation: Helping at the campus garden
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between two students.

audio.text: Hi, are you in charge of the campus garden? I'd like to help out.
That's great! We work every Saturday morning, from nine to twelve.
No, we'll show you everything. Just wear old clothes and bring a bottle of water. We have gloves and tools for everyone.

questions.stem: What does the woman want to do?

why.en: Main idea: "I'd like to help out". D misuses "tools", which the volunteers are given.
why.tr: Ana fikir: "I'd like to help out". D gönüllülere verilen "tools" kelimesini yanlış kullanıyor.
why.es: Idea principal: "I'd like to help out". D usa mal "tools", que se les dan a los voluntarios.

why.en: Detail: "bring a bottle of water". A and B are provided by the garden; C contradicts "wear old clothes".
why.tr: Ayrıntı: "bring a bottle of water". A ve B bahçe tarafından veriliyor; C "wear old clothes" ile çelişiyor.
why.es: Detalle: "bring a bottle of water". A y B los pone el huerto; C contradice "wear old clothes".
